BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

 IN THE MATTER OF SOUTHWESTERN PUBLIC                         )
 SERVICE COMPANY’S APPLICATION FOR: (1)                       )
 REVISION OF ITS RETAIL RATES UNDER                           )      Docket No. 25-00079-UT
 ADVICE NOTICE 341; AND (2) OTHER                             )
 ASSOCIATED RELIEF                                            )


            ORDER APPOINTING SUBSTITUTE CO-HEARING EXAMINER

       THIS MATTER comes before the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission upon its

own motion due to internal personnel changes within the Commission. The Commission appoints

a substitute co-hearing examiner to preside over this matter with Co-Hearing Examiner Patrick

Schaefer.

                                     FINDING AND CONCLUSION
       1.      Due to internal personnel changes within the Commission, it is necessary to appoint

a substitute co-hearing examiner to preside over this case.

       2.      The appointment of a substitute co-hearing examiner will provide administrative

efficiency and assist in the orderly and timely resolution of this matter.

       IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED:

       A.      Hearing Examiner Keven Gedko is hereby appointed Co-Hearing Examiner with

Co-Hearing Examiner Patrick Schaefer to preside over this matter, take all action necessary and

convenient within the limits of their authority, conduct any necessary hearings, and take any other

action in this case that is consistent with law, including issuing of a recommended decision.

       B.       This Order is effective when signed.

       C.      This Order shall be served upon the parties in the current service list for this docket.
       D.       In computing time in accordance with statute, regulation, or Commission order, the

computation shall begin on the date that this Order is filed with the Chief Clerk of the

Commission’s Records Management Bureau or the Chief Clerk’s designee.

      SIGNED under the Seal of the Commission at Santa Fe, New Mexico, this 5th day of

March, 2026.

                        NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

                        /s/ Greg Nibert, electronically signed
                        GREG NIBERT, COMMISSIONER
